title: Liquids - Densities vs. Pressure and Temperature Change
description: Calculate the density of a liquid when changing both temperature and pressure. This tool uses the combined effects of thermal expansion and pressure compression on liquid density.

components.content:
## Liquid Density Calculator

The density of a liquid changes with both temperature and pressure. This calculator computes the final density using the formula:

**ρ₁ = ρ₀ / ((1 + β(t₁ - t₀)) × (1 - (p₁ - p₀)/E))**

Where:
- ρ₁ = final density
- ρ₀ = initial density
- β = volumetric temperature expansion coefficient
- t₁ - t₀ = temperature change
- p₁ - p₀ = pressure change
- E = bulk modulus (liquid elasticity)

### Common Volumetric Expansion Coefficients (β):
- Water: 0.0002 (m³/m³ °C)
- Ethyl alcohol: 0.0011 (m³/m³ °C)

### Common Bulk Moduli (E):
- Water: 2.15×10⁹ (N/m²)
- Ethyl alcohol: 1.06×10⁹ (N/m²)
- Oil: 1.5×10⁹ (N/m²)

outputs.label: Density Change
outputs.formula: inputs.rho0 / ((1 + inputs.beta * inputs.temp_change) * (1 - (inputs.pressure_final - inputs.pressure_initial) / inputs.bulk_modulus)) - inputs.rho0

outputs.label: Density Change (%)
outputs.formula: ((inputs.rho0 / ((1 + inputs.beta * inputs.temp_change) * (1 - (inputs.pressure_final - inputs.pressure_initial) / inputs.bulk_modulus)) - inputs.rho0) / inputs.rho0) * 100
